name: deploy-verify
title: Deploy Verification Loop
description: After a deploy, polls health endpoints and runs smoke tests in a loop until stable or rollback threshold reached. Inspired by loops.elorm.xyz 'Deploy Verification Loop' pattern.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: smoke_tests
inputs.description: Comma-separated curl checks or npm test pattern to run

inputs.name: stable_streak
inputs.description: Consecutive healthy checks required to declare success

inputs.name: max_attempts
inputs.description: Max checks before declaring deploy failed

inputs.name: rollback_command
inputs.description: Command to run on failure (e.g. fly deploy --image previous)

agents.prompt: Check health of {{base_url}}{{health_path}} using curl with a 10s timeout. Return: status (up/down/degraded), http_code, response_time_ms, body_excerpt (first 200 chars).
Run smoke tests against {{base_url}}. Tests to run: {{smoke_tests}}. For each: execute, capture exit code and output. Return: all_passed (bool), failures (list of test name + error).
Deploy verification failed after {{max_attempts}} attempts. Execute rollback: `{{rollback_command}}`. Report rollback outcome and notify human.
